title: Construction Lien Affidavit – Barrett vs. Duran Construction
text:
AFFIDAVIT OF MECHANIC'S AND MATERIALMAN'S LIEN

STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF HARRIS

BEFORE ME, the undersigned authority, personally appeared John Michael Barrett, hereinafter referred to as “Claimant,” who being duly sworn, deposes and states as follows:

1. Claimant is an individual residing at 1420 Oakwood Lane, Houston, Texas 77002, and is the owner of the real property described in Exhibit A attached hereto.

2. On or about March 15, 2023, Claimant entered into a written contract with Duran Construction, LLC (hereinafter “Contractor”), a Texas limited liability company with its principal place of business at 8900 Commerce Drive, Houston, Texas 77036, for the construction of a single-family residence at the above-described property.

3. Pursuant to said contract, Claimant paid Contractor the sum of $125,000.00 as a deposit. Contractor commenced work but subsequently failed to pay subcontractors and suppliers, resulting in liens being filed against the property.

4. Specifically, on June 1, 2023, Claimant received a notice of nonpayment from Texas Building Supply, Inc., a supplier of lumber and materials, in the amount of $45,000.00. Additionally, on June 15, 2023, Claimant received a notice from ABC Electric, LLC, an electrical subcontractor, claiming $12,500.00 for work performed.

5. Claimant has made repeated demands upon Contractor to cure the defaults, but Contractor has failed and refused to do so. As a result, Claimant has incurred damages in the total amount of $57,500.00, plus interest, attorney's fees, and costs.

6. This affidavit is made for the purpose of perfecting a mechanic's and materialman's lien against the property under Chapter 53 of the Texas Property Code. Specifically, § 53.054 of the Texas Property Code provides that “a lien claimant must file an affidavit with the county clerk not later than the 15th day of the fourth month after the day the claimant’s indebtedness accrues.”

7. Claimant has not previously filed a lien affidavit for this claim, and this lien is not based upon any prior lien or security interest.

8. The names and addresses of all persons known to Claimant who may claim an interest in the property are as follows:

a. Duran Construction, LLC, 8900 Commerce Drive, Houston, Texas 77036
b. Texas Building Supply, Inc., 4500 Industrial Blvd., Houston, Texas 77040
c. ABC Electric, LLC, 2500 Elm Street, Houston, Texas 77003

9. Claimant has attached hereto a copy of the contract, the notices of nonpayment, and other supporting documentation.

10. The SSN of Claimant is 987-65-4321. Claimant’s date of birth is May 14, 1975. Claimant’s phone number is (713) 555-0198, and his email address is j.barrett@email.com.

11. The cause number for this matter is 2023-45678; the docket number is CV-23-9876.

12. This affidavit is made under the jurisdiction of the 234th Judicial District Court of Harris County, Texas. The Honorable Judge Patricia Ann Williams presides over this court. Claimant is represented by counsel, Ms. Sarah K. Mitchell of Mitchell & Associates, P.C., located at 1000 Main Street, Suite 300, Houston, Texas 77002. The opposing party, Duran Construction, is represented by its attorney, Mr. David R. Thompson of Thompson Law Firm, 500 Broadway, Houston, Texas 77008.

13. Claimant has cited the following authorities in support of this lien: 42 S.W.3d 123 (Tex. App.—Houston [1st Dist.] 2001) and 789 S.W.2d 456 (Tex. 1990). In the case of Barrett v. Duran Construction, the court held that a contractor’s failure to pay subcontractors gives rise to a valid mechanic’s lien. Additionally, the case In re Duran Construction, 567 S.W.3d 890 (Tex. 2019), is instructive on the issue of lien priority.

14. Claimant swears that the facts set forth in this affidavit are true and correct to the best of his knowledge and belief.

/s/ John M. Barrett (also known as “Johnny” or “J.M. Barrett”)

SUBSCRIBED AND SWORN TO before me this 20th day of December, 2023, by John Michael Barrett, who is personally known to me or who produced a driver’s license as identification.

/s/ Notary Public

My Commission Expires: June 30, 2025

title: Construction Lien Affidavit – Cooper vs. Anderson Builders
text:
AFFIDAVIT OF MECHANIC'S LIEN

STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF DALLAS

BEFORE ME, the undersigned authority, personally appeared Emily Rose Cooper, hereinafter referred to as “Lien Claimant,” who being duly sworn, deposes and states as follows:

1. Lien Claimant is an individual residing at 2301 Maple Avenue, Apt. 4B, Dallas, Texas 75201, and is the owner of the commercial property described in Exhibit A attached hereto.

2. On or about November 1, 2022, Lien Claimant entered into a written contract with Anderson Builders, Inc. (hereinafter “Contractor”), a Texas corporation with its principal place of business at 1500 Elm Street, Dallas, Texas 75202, for the renovation of a retail space located at the above-described property.

3. The contract price was $200,000.00, and Lien Claimant made payments totaling $150,000.00. However, Contractor failed to complete the work and failed to pay certain subcontractors, including Lone Star Plumbing, Inc. and Elite Roofing, LLC.

4. On January 10, 2023, Lone Star Plumbing, Inc. filed a lien affidavit against the property in the amount of $25,000.00. On February 5, 2023, Elite Roofing, LLC filed a lien affidavit in the amount of $18,000.00. Lien Claimant has been forced to pay these amounts to avoid foreclosure.

5. Lien Claimant now seeks to assert a lien for the amounts paid to discharge the subcontractor liens, plus interest, attorney's fees, and costs.

6. This affidavit is made pursuant to Texas Property Code § 53.082, which states: “A person who pays a subcontractor or supplier may claim a lien for the amount paid.”

7. The names and addresses of all persons known to Lien Claimant who may claim an interest in the property are:

a. Anderson Builders, Inc., 1500 Elm Street, Dallas, Texas 75202
b. Lone Star Plumbing, Inc., 800 Commerce Street, Dallas, Texas 75204
c. Elite Roofing, LLC, 1200 Industrial Drive, Dallas, Texas 75207

8. Lien Claimant’s SSN is 123 45 6789. Her date of birth is March 3, 1980. Her phone number is (214) 555-0142, and her email address is emily.cooper@mail.com.

9. The cause number for this proceeding is DC-23-12345; the docket number is 2023-CV-5678.

10. This affidavit is filed in the 101st Judicial District Court of Dallas County, Texas, presided over by the Honorable Judge Michael T. Roberts. Lien Claimant is represented by counsel, Mr. James A. Wilson of Wilson & Hart, LLP, located at 2000 Main Street, Dallas, Texas 75201. The opposing party, Anderson Builders, is represented by its attorney, Ms. Laura K. Anderson (who is also the owner of Anderson Builders, Inc.) of Anderson Law Firm, 500 Park Avenue, Dallas, Texas 75202.

11. Lien Claimant relies upon the following authorities: 123 S.W.3d 456 (Tex. App.—Dallas 2003) and 456 S.W.3d 789 (Tex. 2015). In the case of Cooper v. Anderson Builders, the court held that a property owner may recover amounts paid to discharge subcontractor liens. Additionally, the case In re Anderson Builders, 234 S.W.3d 890 (Tex. 2008), discusses lien priority issues.

12. Lien Claimant swears that the facts set forth in this affidavit are true and correct.

/s/ Emily R. Cooper (also known as “Emmy” or “E.R. Cooper”)

SUBSCRIBED AND SWORN TO before me this 15th day of January, 2024, by Emily Rose Cooper, who is personally known to me or who produced a valid Texas driver’s license.

/s/ Notary Public

My Commission Expires: December 31, 2025

title: Construction Lien Affidavit – Martinez vs. Summit Construction
text:
AFFIDAVIT OF MATERIALMAN'S LIEN

STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF TRAVIS

BEFORE ME, the undersigned authority, personally appeared Carlos A. Martinez, hereinafter referred to as “Claimant,” who being duly sworn, deposes and states as follows:

1. Claimant is an individual residing at 3400 Lake Shore Drive, Austin, Texas 78701, and is the owner of the commercial building described in Exhibit A.

2. On or about July 1, 2022, Claimant entered into a contract with Summit Construction Co. (hereinafter “Contractor”), a Texas corporation with its principal office at 800 Congress Avenue, Austin, Texas 78701, for the construction of a parking garage.

3. Claimant paid Contractor $300,000.00 as progress payments. However, Contractor failed to pay for materials supplied by Austin Lumber Co., which has filed a lien affidavit in the amount of $60,000.00.

4. Claimant has also received a notice of nonpayment from Travis Plumbing Supply, LLC, in the amount of $22,000.00.

5. Claimant has been required to pay these amounts to protect his property. Claimant now asserts a lien for the total of $82,000.00, plus interest and costs.

6. This affidavit is made under Texas Property Code § 53.081, which states: “A person who pays a subcontractor or supplier may claim a lien for the amount paid.”

7. The following persons may have an interest in the property:

a. Summit Construction Co., 800 Congress Avenue, Austin, Texas 78701
b. Austin Lumber Co., 500 Industrial Lane, Austin, Texas 78702
c. Travis Plumbing Supply, LLC, 2000 Riverside Drive, Austin, Texas 78704

8. Claimant’s SSN is 456-78-9012. His date of birth is October 12, 1968. His phone number is (512) 555-0192, and his email address is carlos.martinez@workmail.com.

9. The cause number is 2024-CA-3456; the docket number is D-1-GN-23-00789.

10. This affidavit is filed in the 345th Judicial District Court of Travis County, Texas, presided over by the Honorable Judge Susan B. Lee. Claimant is represented by counsel, Mr. Robert K. Nguyen of Nguyen & Associates, P.C., located at 100 West 6th Street, Austin, Texas 78701. The opposing party, Summit Construction, is represented by its attorney, Ms. Jennifer R. Thompson of Thompson & Reed, LLP, 300 East 8th Street, Austin, Texas 78701.

11. Claimant relies upon the following authorities: 567 S.W.3d 123 (Tex. App.—Austin 2020) and 890 S.W.3d 456 (Tex. 2022). In the case of Martinez v. Summit Construction, the court upheld a materialman’s lien for materials supplied. Also, In re Summit Construction, 123 S.W.3d 789 (Tex. 2017), addresses lien priority.

12. Claimant swears that the facts set forth are true and correct.

/s/ Carlos A. Martinez (also known as “Charlie” or “C.A. Martinez”)

SUBSCRIBED AND SWORN TO before me this 5th day of March, 2024, by Carlos A. Martinez, who is personally known to me.

/s/ Notary Public

My Commission Expires: August 15, 2025
